title: Analista De Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história. A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes. Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país. E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras. Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades. Responsabilidades e atribuições Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
Participar dadefinição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
Participar dadefinição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
Apoiar revisões fiscais de contratos;
Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
Atendimento àfiscalização e auditoria;
Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária. Requisitos e qualificações Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);
Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Planejamento Fiscal ou Direito Tributário;
Conhecimento em sistemas fiscais e ERPs SAP Diferencial. Informações adicionais O Que Temos Para Você

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

title: Engenheiro Eletricista
description:
Engenheiro Eletricista | Sistemas Embarcados e Plataformas Marítimas


Sobre a Tidewise

A Tidewise é uma empresa brasileira pioneira no desenvolvimento, integração e operação de sistemas robóticos inteligentes voltados para as demandas da indústria marítima. Nossa missão é acelerar a transição para um setor mais seguro e sustentável, utilizando tecnologia de ponta para aumentar a segurança, confiabilidade e eficiência, ao mesmo tempo em que reduzimos o impacto ambiental e os custos operacionais.


Descrição da Vaga

A Tidewise está em busca de um(a) Engenheiro Elétricista com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de sistemas elétricos embarcados, domínio de ferramentas CAD para projeto elétrico (especialmente SolidWorks Electrical ) e conhecimento em documentação técnica para fabricação e montagem.


Essa pessoa atuará diretamente com as equipes de engenharia, produção e integração de sistemas, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento detalhado, montagem e validação de sistemas elétricos e eletrônicos em plataformas robóticas marítimas inovadoras.


Trata-se de uma posição prática, com impacto direto nos produtos da empresa, que exige organização, atenção aos detalhes, capacidade de lidar com diferentes etapas do ciclo de vida de um projeto e boa comunicação entre áreas.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver projetos elétricos a partir de conceitos e requisitos de sistema , incluindo a definição da arquitetura elétrica, estratégias de controle e interfaces entre subsistemas.
  • Realizar estudos de balanço de carga , dimensionamento de circuitos, proteções, fontes de energia e consumo elétrico dos sistemas embarcados.
  • Desenvolver esquemáticos elétricos, diagramas de conexão e layout de painéis no SolidWorks Electrical, em colaboração com os engenheiros eletricistas.
  • Criar modelos e desenhos 3D de montagem elétrica utilizando o SolidWorks Mecânico (3D) , em colaboração com os engenheiros eletricistas e mecanicos.
  • Realizar projeto e roteamento de placas de circuito impresso (PCBs)
  • Elaborar documentação técnica de montagem e checklists de instalação elétrica.
  • Desenvolver planos e procedimentos de teste para sistemas elétricos e eletrônicos.
  • Troubleshooting de sistemas, tanto em bancada quanto a bordo.
  • Preparar e organizar bancadas de teste e validação.
  • Atualizar a documentação técnica “as built ” conforme modificações ocorridas durante montagem e testes.
  • Realizar o controle técnico de montagem e supervisar a instalação elétrica.
  • Criação, atualização e manutenção de listas de materiais no sistem ERP (BOMs);
  • Pesquisa de fornecedores e solicitação de orçamentos;


Requisitos

  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada com software CAD para projetos elétricos (ex: SolidWorks Electrical, EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical).
  • Experiência com roteamento de PCBs e uso de ferramentas como Altium Designer , Eagle ou KiCAD .
  • Capacidade de desenvolver documentação técnica clara e organizada para montagem e operação.
  • Inglês técnico escrito , com capacidade de leitura e elaboração de documentação técnica.
  • Experiência em ambiente de produção, montagem ou campo, com foco em integração de sistemas elétricos.
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes, com compromisso com a qualidade da documentação.
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar.


Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência com SolidWorks Electrical e SolidWorks Mecânico 3D .
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de automação, incluindo CLPs e microcontroladores .
  • Familiaridade com normas ABNT , especialmente NBR 5410 (instalações elétricas de baixa tensão).
  • Certificação ou conhecimento prático da NR10 – Segurança em Instalações e Serviços em Eletricidade.
  • Vivência em sistemas embarcados, marítimos ou robóticos.
  • Experiência com ERP e processos de compras técnicas.


O Que Oferecemos

  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos inovadores e de alto impacto na indústria marítima e robótica.
  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, dinâmico e em constante evolução tecnológica.
  • Contato direto com todas as etapas do desenvolvimento de produto, da concepção à operação.
  • Salário e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado.
  • Participação em uma empresa que está moldando o futuro da tecnologia naval e robótica marítima.

Junte-se à Tidewise e participe da revolução tecnológica no setor marítimo! ⚡⚓

title: Product Owner
description:
Procuramos um profissional talentoso e experiente para atuar como PMO (Project Management Officer) ou PO (Project Owner) em um projeto estratégico de Data Visualization de alta complexidade para nosso cliente. O projeto envolve a transformação de grandes volumes de dados em insights acionáveis através de dashboards e relatórios. O candidato deve ser fluente em inglês para gerenciar e colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento, stakeholders e parceiros em nível global.

Responsabilidades Principais

Gestão de Projeto/Produto:

PMO Foco: Gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo do projeto, incluindo escopo, cronograma, orçamento, riscos e qualidade, garantindo que os objetivos estratégicos sejam alcançados dentro do prazo.

PO Foco: Definir, priorizar e manter o Product Backlog do projeto de DataViz, traduzindo as necessidades dos stakeholders e do cliente em histórias de usuário claras e critérios de aceitação.

Comunicação Global: Atuar como o principal ponto de contato, facilitando a comunicação clara e eficaz entre o cliente, stakeholders executivos e os times técnicos distribuídos globalmente.

Análise e Requisitos de Dados: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com analistas de dados e designers para refinar os requisitos de visualização, garantindo que os dashboards atendam às necessidades de informação e apresentem a narrativa correta.

Governança: Estabelecer e manter padrões, processos e métricas de desempenho (KPIs) para o projeto, garantindo a transparência e o alinhamento estratégico.

Mitigação de Riscos: Identificar proativamente riscos e impedimentos, desenvolvendo planos de mitigação e escalando problemas quando necessário.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

Experiência Comprovada: experiência atuando como PMO, Gerente de Projetos ou Product Owner em projetos de alta complexidade e grande escala.

Proficiência em Inglês: Fluência obrigatória (escrita e conversação) para comunicação diária com times e stakeholders internacionais.

Metodologias: Forte conhecimento e experiência prática com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e/ou tradicionais (PMBOK).

Data & DataViz: Sólida compreensão dos conceitos de Data Visualization, Business Intelligence (BI) e Storytelling com dados. Capacidade de entender a estrutura de dados e como ela suporta a visualização final.

Habilidades de Comunicação: Excelente habilidade de comunicação, negociação e gestão de conflitos, com experiência em interagir em nível executivo.

Conhecimentos Desejáveis (Um Diferencial)

Ferramentas de DataViz: Experiência prática com ferramentas líderes de mercado como Tableau, Power BI ou Looker Studio (Google Data Studio).

Certificações: Certificações relevantes (e.G., PMP, PSM/CSM, SAFe).

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Platform Engineer (AWS / Terraform / Kafka) – Fintech Payments Platform

Location: Remote (UK/EU time zones)

Contract: 7 months (to April 2026)


Start: ASAP

Tech Stack: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes/EKS, Kafka, GitOps, Cloud-Native Tooling

Focus: Platform engineering & solution build (not ops/DevOps)


About the Role

We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to join a major UK retail group building a new Klarna-style fintech payments platform. This role sits at the heart of the cloud platform team and focuses on designing, building, and automating the core infrastructure that powers high-scale financial transactions.

You’ll work in a highly technical environment, collaborating with architects, backend engineers, and security teams to deliver secure, resilient, cloud-native foundations. This is a hands-on build role — not day-to-day ops or DevOps support.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Build & Infrastructure Engineering

  • Design and implement scalable, resilient cloud platform components in AWS
  • Own Infrastructure as Code using Terraform (modular, reusable architectures)
  • Build secure multi-account AWS environments following Well-Architected principles
  • Develop internal platform tooling, automation, templates, and golden paths
  • Support EKS/Kubernetes environments and microservice deployment foundations

Event-Driven & Distributed Architecture

  • Build and support Kafka-based event streaming and messaging capabilities
  • Ensure high availability, reliability, and idempotent service patterns
  • Work with engineers to define infrastructure for distributed, real-time systems

Observability, Reliability & Performance

  • Implement monitoring, alerting, logging, and distributed tracing (Datadog/Grafana/ELK)
  • Ensure SLAs/SLOs for platform components are met
  • Contribute to disaster recovery design, multi-region readiness, and resilience testing

Security, Governance & Compliance

  • Enforce best practices for IAM, secrets management, encryption, and network security
  • Build guardrails, policies, and automated compliance into CI/CD and IaC workflows
  • Contribute to platform risk assessments and mitigation strategies

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Partner with architects, platform leads, and product teams to translate requirements into technical designs
  • Work with developers to guide best practices for cloud-native builds
  • Mentor engineers in IaC, automation, and platform engineering patterns

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • 5+ years in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering
  • Strong experience with AWS (multi-account, networking, security, core services)
  • Excellent Terraform skills, building modular and production-grade IaC
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes / EKS or similar orchestration platforms
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming technologies
  • Hands-on with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD)
  • Strong understanding of monitoring, distributed tracing, and observability
  • Ability to work autonomously in fast-paced, cloud-native engineering teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or high-throughput distributed systems
  • Knowledge of Well-Architected Framework, security engineering, compliance
  • Familiarity with service mesh, API gateways, or serverless components
  • Exposure to Python/Go/TypeScript for automation or tooling

What This Role is Not

  • Not day-to-day ops or support
  • Not traditional DevOps or SRE maintenance
  • Not basic provisioning or infra monitoring
  • Not a junior cloud role

This is a platform build position: architecture + IaC + automation + infrastructure foundations.

  • Comfortable acting as a technical escalation point, providing AWS support via Slack when primary leads are unavailable.
  • Experience creating technical estimates and cost projections for new infrastructure requirements.
  • Advanced english proficiency.

Hi… My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that – if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You'll be working on a newsletter and pling! An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more...Right? I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it. I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You'll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You'll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do). You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that 'makes sense' to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)). My guess is that ifyou are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies! We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We're just on the other side of the world. The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you – running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast-moving, and positive company should. The Contract Details Are As Follows: USD 1,400 a month. 25 hrs a week. Managed via Upwork. Oh, and hey… if you're considering this role as an add-on to an already existing full-time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle. That's it, I think. I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via (contact) with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version). Thanks for reading this far, Lena. Na CASSI somos movidos pelo propósito que é o de “Cuidar do participante em todas as fases da sua vida”, ainda que façamos parte de uma equipe de atividade meio ou fim, nosso propósito é único e sempre voltado ao participante da CASSI.

Precisamos de pessoas que estejam dispostas a aprender e multiplicar conhecimento, avaliar e trocar ideias sobre o processo com a ótica de que podemos estar em constantes mudanças e melhorias.

Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão!

Todas as nossas vagas são abertas a pessoas de todos os perfis, incluindo pessoas com deficiência (PcD), pessoas negras, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+, 50+, entre outros grupos minorizados.

Caso você precise de algum recurso ou adaptação para participar do processo seletivo ou exercer suas atividades, por favor, informe no campo “Descrição das atividades”. Estamos comprometidos em oferecer um ambiente acessível e acolhedor para todos.

  • Realizar assistência médica respeitando as premissas do Código de Ética Médica.

Caixa de Assistência dos Funcionários do Banco do Brasil

A CASSI foi fundada em 27 de janeiro de 1944 por um grupo de funcionários do BB, com o objetivo de ressarcir as despesas de saúde dessa população. Nestas oito décadas, a Empresa experimentou grande desenvolvimento, tornando-se uma das maiores instituições sem fins lucrativos administradoras de planos de saúde do País. As 27 Unidades, instaladas em todos os Estados do País, proporcionam atendimento acolhedor e diferenciado.

O diferencial da Caixa de Assistência está na proposta de atendimento integral, focado na promoção da saúde e na prevenção de doenças, por meio da Estratégia Saúde da Família. Assim, é pioneira entre os planos de saúde brasileiros na oferta de programas e atividades coletivas em saúde, voltados para melhoria dos hábitos de vida, nutrição, atividade física, realização de consultas periódicas e exames de rotina, além de proporcionar o acompanhamento adequado dos portadores de doenças crônicas.

title: Design Director, Ui/Ux & Brand
description:
Design Director, UI/UX & Brand

Join to apply for the Design Director, UI/UX & Brand role at Darkroom

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About The Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

This role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior‑level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e‑commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities
  • Lead 1-3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites.
  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.
  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.
  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.
  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.
Management Responsibilities
  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.
  • Ensure high‑quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.
  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.
You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You
  • 3-6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e-commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.
  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.
  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.
  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.
  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.
  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.
  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.
Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in‑office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.
Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Head Of Media Operations & Services
description:
Head of Media Operations & Services

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Responsible for the successful implementation of the Media Operations & Services at all stadiums in Brazil for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Media Operations is a very important function in the organisation, as this area provides the services and conditions for all media to report about the competition to millions of viewers, listeners and readers around the world.

Reporting organisationally to FIFA Zurich HQ Lead Media Operations & Services, the HoD Media Operations & Services will be a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team, and work in close collaboration with Venue Management, Team Services, Competition Management, Media Partnerships, Host Broadcast Operations, Host City Rights Management and other key individuals responsible for planning, delivering and managing Media operations & Services for the more than 2000 national and international media expected to attend the FIFA Women’s World Cup. Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women’s Football Strategy.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Responsible for detailed planning and implementation of media facilities & services in the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 stadiums based on the FIFA HQ MEO strategy.
  • Manage and contribute to the Senior Media operations manager and Senior Media services work
  • Define functional area’s Entity budget requirements and finalise budget reviews.
  • Manage, contribute, supervise the implementation of the scope and delivery of media-dedicated services, including technology, accommodation, accreditation, catering and transport.
  • Contribute and supervise the implementation of the media-dedicated spaces and flows, in all competition and non-competition venues in collaboration with other key functional areas.
  • Liaise with the Host Cities to define media-dedicated areas and services.
  • Engage with local and international media to support the requirements needs and ensure the delivery of operations is set to the highest standards.
  • Define and implement a rate card solution for International News Agencies and other key media outlets in coordination with technology.
  • Organise relevant workshops and meetings (media workshops, agency visits etc.)
  • Hire and deploy event-time staff – in coordination with FIFA Zurich HQ - Venue Media Managers & Venue Media Coordinators - in the various stadiums, managing all logistics and administrative tasks.
  • Event-time, manage and coordinate the venue media staff & services for all matches across the various venues.
  • Define and contribute to the information tools and supports (FIFA Media app content, media guide) for media in general, potentially other target groups on operations and services
  • Support the FIFA Media Department & Local Entity with media operations & services during events.
  • Contribute to the promotion of the tournament supporting FIFA and Local Entity departments involved
  • Manage planning, preparations and fulfilment of inspections to the FWWC 2027 stadiums and various other locations where media will be working
  • Participate in the development and management of trainings, workshops and production of information for media-related workforce and volunteers
  • Organises media conferences, media days and other media activities
  • Oversee and deliver a complete and detailed reporting of media operations and services progress to the FIFA Zurich responsible.
YOUR PROFILE
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
  • Higher education qualification in media or sports event management
  • 5+ years’ experience in the sports industry, with an emphasis on media operations (broadcast is a plus)
  • 5-7 years’ experience in sports project management, preferably in football
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, Spanish and/or French proficiency is a plus
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Head Of Brand, Marketing And Promotion
description:
Head of Brand, Marketing and Promotion

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • This person and department will be responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property. This includes, but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.
YOUR PROFILE
  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position(s)
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus
  • Experience working in a global or international environment
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient
  • Financial and budget management
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro

title: Airport Operations Director
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide. Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards. Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team. Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to): Operational Leadership Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics. Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators. IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business. Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives. Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager. Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards. Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development. Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed. CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager. Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required. Team Development Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start. Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training. Compliance & QHSE Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement. Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements. Commercial Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed. Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects. Team Culture and Engagement Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives. Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team. Client Account Management Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary. Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities. Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department. Coordination Responsibilities Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment. Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments. Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins. Qualifications and Skills Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role. Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore. Proficient in MS Office;
CRM experience preferred. Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments. Personal Attributes Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking. Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary. Additional Information: This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth. Travel Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region. HSE Awareness: All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations. Why Join Us? This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector. We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated. Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation. Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

title: Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions
description:
Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and.>

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions in various locations to drive partnerships for licensing and embedding Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro into software and SaaS solutions.

Canonical supports ISV customers and alliances in building on Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro, which helps them deliver fast, reliable, secure, compliant and consistent solutions.

We offer the world's most extensive base of open source software, backed by comprehensive SLA support, FIPS‑certified cryptographic compliance, and security commitments that meet HIPAA and FedRAMP standards. We are the top‑rated operating system for developers. Partnering with every major public cloud provider, we ensure Ubuntu is optimized and seamlessly integrated with their unique services, making it easier for ISVs to deploy solutions confidently across multi‑cloud environments. Additionally, we collaborate with leading server manufacturers, IoT providers, and silicon vendors to enable, optimize, and certify Ubuntu on their hardware. This makes Ubuntu an exceptional choice for ISVs selling physical appliances or traditional software solutions.

The world's biggest brands in AI build on these Ubuntu Pro capabilities to ensure they stay focused on their product proposition rather than maintenance or compliance.

Location

Multiple openings in the Americas and in E time zones.

Role Overview

The Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions will collaborate with Product, Alliances, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing colleagues to prospect into ISV accounts, introduce our offerings, and help partners or potential customers develop their products to best leverage our portfolio. The successful candidate will:

  • Drive embedded support and licensing sales with ISVs to exceed quarterly and annual booking targets.
  • Lead customer and partner relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales, customer success and support lifecycle.
  • Deepen understanding and engagement with the open source ecosystem.
  • Identify and develop partnerships that support Canonical's strategic ambitions.
  • Collaborate with product management to ensure fitness and enhancement of our platforms and solutions for ISVs.
  • Negotiate contracts with new and existing ISV partners and customers.
  • Shape our content and messaging for ISV partners and customers.

What We Are Looking For

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about an alternative chosen path.
  • Ability to establish strategic relationships with large organisations at all levels.
  • A passion for technology and extensive experience with the software and SaaS industry, Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred), the open source ecosystem, cloud models, and container service offerings.
  • Experience with lead generation and business development in the software sector.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.
  • Outstanding business English writing and presentation skills.
  • A personal drive to meet commitments and a track record of delivering beyond expectations.
  • A commitment to leadership, skills development and mentorship.
  • An appreciation of diversity and effectiveness in a multicultural, multi‑national organisation.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

What We Offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Additional Information

Employment type: Full‑time

Job function: Sales and Business Development

Industries: Software Development

title: Senior Legal Counsel (Chemicals and Retail)- Relocate to Saudi Arabia
description:
Senior Legal Counsel (Chemicals and Retail) - Relocate to Saudi Arabia

Join to apply for the Senior Legal Counsel (Chemicals and Retail) - Relocate to Saudi Arabia role at ARAMCO .

Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world and a top global company by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced attorney to join the Chemicals & Retail Legal Practice of the Downstream Law Department within the Aramco Law Organization.

The Practice provides legal support to many downstream entities, primarily from a shareholder and governance perspective, with a focus on general corporate and commercial contracts.

As Counsel, your primary role is to provide legal advice to Saudi Aramco and its subsidiaries, particularly in the area of commercial agreements for the supply and offtake of Saudi Aramco’s wide array of products, including long‑term crude and product sales/placements, crude importation, long‑term refined product/chemical offtakes, processing/netting agreements, tolling arrangements and international hydrocarbon trading.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the corporate secretary for one or more entities, organizing and managing board meetings, and advising as to board authority and corporate governance matters.
  • Advise as to shareholder issues and manage the interface between the entity, the parent, and other affiliates.
  • Work closely with internal Saudi Aramco Downstream clients and support their substantial and complex contracting and purchasing functions.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate contracts, O&M agreements, service agreements, and other commercial contracts and related agreements, including complex products supply and offtake agreements.
  • Advise on internal policies, review and resolve claims, and provide training to company personnel on a variety of legal matters.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Law degree minimum; Master or Juris degree preferred.
  • Current admission to general practice before the highest court of the state or country of which you are a citizen or resident.
  • A minimum of 7 years progressive experience gained in a sophisticated law firm or corporation. A mix of private practice and in‑house experience would be preferred.
  • Relevant commercial contracts and general corporate experience, particularly in the downstream chemicals and retail sectors.
  • Excellent negotiation and communication skills.
  • Experience providing concise and clear support to clients and leadership, and mentorship experience.

Work Location and Work Schedule

Work Location: Within Saudi Arabia – to be specified in Job Offer.

Work Schedule: Full Time – to be specified in Job Offer.

title: Design Director, UI/UX & Brand
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

This role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior‑level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e‑commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

  • Lead 1‑3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e‑commerce websites.

  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2‑4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

  • Ensure high‑quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

  • 3‑6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.

  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Team Leadership & External Coordination

One year in Norway, a career in Brazil—grow with us across borders

About Solution Seeker

Solution Seeker - with headquarters in Norway and a subsidiary in Brazil - is a scaleup building software and AI for industrial production optimization, turning data into value and strategic insight for our users.

Our software streams live sensor data from production facilities worldwide, processed in an event-driven, distributed system using patented algorithms to identify stable periods and select the most valuable data points for our machine learning models.

On top of this, we develop applications that help customers visualize and contextualize their data with our predictions and analyses, enabling them to make better production decisions. Beyond client work, we dedicate significant time and resources to cutting-edge machine learning research, including generative and probabilistic modeling, hybrid modeling (combining physics and ML), data-driven production optimization, and closed-loop identification.

As a Data Scientist, you will work hands-on with our data and play a key role in addressing some of the most important technical and strategic challenges we face. Your tasks may include:

  • Analyzing large volumes of production data to solve real customer challenges
  • Developing and optimizing our machine learning models
  • Designing and building applications based on customer needs
  • Preparing and delivering insightful presentations internally and externally
  • Contributing to strategic initiatives such as go-to-market plans, positioning, and delivery models

You’ll develop both technical and business expertise in a growing scaleup, giving you a strong foundation for future growth, whether you aim to specialize technically, move into business roles, or step into leadership.

About you

In addition to being technically skilled, you are naturally curious and never back down from a challenge. You are generous and accountable, always seeking to include others rather than exclude them. Your playful nature and willingness to contribute to the work environment make you a valuable team member because you know that happy developers mean happy customers.

You thrive in a young, international, fast-paced environment where your passion for continuous learning and innovation drives your success. Join us and be part of a team that embraces curiosity, warmth, playfulness, and punchiness as we create groundbreaking solutions and strengthen our position as world-leading experts in our field

Requirements

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese , both written and spoken (English will be your main working language)
  • Willingness to live 12 months in Oslo, Norway (from Feb 2026) and return to Rio to join the Brazilian team once your initial rotation is over.
  • Interest in digitalization, machine learning, and AI
  • Basic understanding of programming and strong logical reasoning skills
  • Ability to take initiative and deliver results
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Being Brazilian or possessing a valid work permit to work in Brazil (once your rotation in Oslo is over)
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field
  • Our tech stack is large and we do not expect you to know all of it, but any familiarity would be greatly appreciated skills
  • Familiarity with Python
  • Experience working with large datasets
  • Experience/knowledge of Plotly Dash
  • Experience studying or working abroad
  • Experience with simulation, optimization, and modeling
  • Master’s degree in engineering or a related field

What we offer

To give you the best possible start before joining our Rio de Janeiro team, you’ll spend your first year with us at our headquarters in Oslo, where you’ll get a full onboarding into the company, our people, and our way of working. We will provide assistance related to obtaining the necessary visas/work permits before you can relocate to Oslo, and we will offer a competitive remuneration package for your stay in Norway, so you can focus on learning, contributing to the company, and enjoying the experience.

At Solution Seeker, we believe work should be both meaningful and fun. You’ll have the freedom to shape your own workday, with opportunities to explore different teams and projects based on your interests.

Our culture is young, social, and collaborative—we enjoy lunch runs, after-work beers, company trips. Once back in Rio, you’ll carry that spirit with you, working closely with our Oslo team while enjoying the energy of our Brazilian office (and yes, the beaches are right there when you need them).

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking a Senior Legal Counsel to join the Gas Corporate & Commercial Legal Practice in the Upstream Law Department within the Aramco Law Organization.

As Senior Counsel, your primary role is to provide comprehensive corporate and commercial legal services, working closely with internal stakeholders and coordinating with specialist legal teams in areas such as tax, intellectual property (IP), mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and dispute resolution.   • Serve as Board Secretary for designated joint ventures and subsidiaries.
  • Manage relationships with external legal counsel, including oversight of legal budgets and service quality.

Main responsibilities

Se você é uma pessoa apaixonada por dados e gostaria de aplicar seus conhecimentos para criar modelos de predição focados em performance de negócios, essa vaga é para você!

Como Data Scientist Specialist II, você irá atuar junto com um time multidisciplinar e apoio de áreas especializadas em Ciência de Dados, transformando dados em valor e contribuindo para os planejamentos junto ao time de negócio. Será responsável por desenvolver modelos, análises e experimentos de pricing que apoiem decisões estratégicas de precificação, otimizem receita e impulsionem o crescimento do negócio.

  • Explorar e analisar grandes volumes de dados para gerar insights acionáveis;
  • Construir, treinar e validar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning voltados para performance de negócios;
  • Colaborar com times de Produto, Engenharia e Negócios para entender problemas, levantar hipóteses e propor soluções baseadas em dados;
  • Comunicar resultados de forma clara para stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Desenvolver pipelines de dados e automações para garantir a escalabilidade das soluções;
  • Monitorar a performance dos modelos em produção e propor melhorias contínuas;
  • Aplicar boas práticas de versionamento, reprodutibilidade e governança de modelos;
  • Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e contribuir com a evolução das práticas de ciência de dados na empresa.

Requirements and skills

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Condução em análises exploratórias e estudos de impacto para embasar decisões estratégicas de pricing.
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL e Python;
  • Experiência em conduzir análises quantitativas robustas e consistentes, desde a definição do problema até a apresentação dos resultados;
  • Habilidade para criar e apresentar storytelling de dados, traduzindo insights técnicos em linguagem acessível para diferentes públicos;

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Planejar, organizar, monitorar e avaliar as atividades técnicas e administrativas assistenciais das unidades de enfermagem. Desenvolver e aperfeiçoar sistemas, rotinas, procedimentos e métodos técnicos/administrativos, tendo em vista uniformizar, simplificar e aumentar a eficácia das atividades dos setores envolvidos.

Requirements and skills

Ensino Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas ou áreas afins;

Pós-Graduação em Administração Hospitalar;

Experiência de no mínimo 6 meses na área Administrativa e Gestão de Equipe.

Additional information

Local: Santa Cruz - RJ

Escala: Segunda a Sexta-feira - 40h semanais.

Horário: 08:00 às 17:00

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.
